stretchedBillboard.description: quads stretched along velocity (streaks, sparks, flame tongues)

meshParticle.description: each particle is a ribbon mesh (swirls, arcs, rings); defines the silhouette of strokes

flipbook.description: texture sheet animation over lifetime (cel flame/smoke/stroke wipes)

additiveBlend.description: additive blending for glows and strokes

alphaBlend.description: straight alpha blending for cel flames, smoke, ink

hdrTint.description: material tint above 1.0; only visible as extra glow when bloom exists

bloom.description: post bloom on HDR values; the anime glow look depends on it

tonemapNeutral.description: Neutral tonemapping of the HDR image

worldSpace.description: particles stay where spawned while the emitter moves (trails)

rateOverDistance.description: emission proportional to emitter travel distance

rotationOverLifetime.description: spinning particles (mesh spin is the swirl motion)

orbitalVelocity.description: positions orbit the layer Y axis (vortex motion)

radialVelocity.description: positions pushed away from the layer origin

travelRoll.description: mesh particle rolls with the distance its system has travelled: extra rotation about local +X of distance / radius (1.17.0, SCHEMA §4.11)

attachedFollow.description: role "attached": the system transform follows a moving entity every frame (buffs/auras, SCHEMA §5)

linkTarget.description: role "link": the system frame spans source → target (two runtime points, every frame) and exposes linkLength (SCHEMA §5)

pathFollow.description: particle position follows a curved path from its spawn point to the link target over its lifetime (SCHEMA §4.8)

salvoSequence.description: top-level salvo: N projectile instances fired one by one from caster-relative slots at fireStart + k·fireInterval (runtime inputs), each stopping its idle systems (SCHEMA §5.2)

instanceScale.description: whole cast scaled uniformly by clamp(input / reference, min, max) from a runtime input: targetHeight or (1.11.0) areaRadius; (1.15.0) only the systems in scale.systems when that list is given (SCHEMA §5.3)

phasedSequence.description: systems with phase begin/sustain/end played on the sequence timeline with a runtime hold duration (SCHEMA §5.1)

depthWrite.description: material writes depth (opaque alpha-blended solid mesh, e.g. a 3D rock): its own faces and later-drawn particles are depth-tested against it (SCHEMA §2 Material, 1.8.0)

flipbookCycles.description: flipbook.cycles > 1: the sheet loops several times per lifetime (flickering flames on long-lived particles, SCHEMA §4.5, 1.9.0)

stopTail.description: onStop.mode "jumpToTail": when the system stops emitting, live particles skip ahead so only `tail` s of life remain (they play their fade/break-up end at once, SCHEMA §4.9, 1.9.0)

modelParticle.description: render.type "model": each particle is an animated 3D model (glTF binary, rigid node hierarchy, node TRS clips, vertex colors; 1.13.0: embedded baseColor textures, toon ramp, outline) shaded by models[].shading (SCHEMA §4.10)

widthScale.description: top-level width: the listed systems are stretched along their right axis by clamp(effectWidth / reference, min, max) from a runtime input; listed layers scale their emission counts by the same factor (SCHEMA §5.4, 1.12.0)

depthScale.description: top-level depth: the listed systems are stretched along their forward axis by clamp(effectDepth / reference, min, max) from a runtime input; with width + height a runtime box size (SCHEMA §5.4, 1.20.0)

heightScale.description: top-level height: the listed systems are stretched along their up axis by clamp(effectHeight / reference, min, max) from a runtime input; listed layers scale their emission counts by the same factor (SCHEMA §5.4, 1.14.0)

staticFacing.description: system orientation "facing": a static system is turned to a runtime horizontal facing given at placement (e.g. a wall raised across the caster's view) instead of world +Z (SCHEMA §5, 1.14.0)

salvoCount.description: salvo.countRange: runtime input shotCount fires only the first n shots; slots k >= n never start their idle systems (SCHEMA §5.2, 1.16.0)

salvoFlight.description: salvo.flight: straight flight at runtime shotSpeed up to runtime shotRange, then the miss system (dissolve); optional launch system at each shot; aimMode converge = every shot aims at the caster's aim point (SCHEMA §5.2, 1.16.0)

followSmoothed.description: system.follow: an attached system trails a caster-relative point with exponential smoothing + hover bob (a companion flying after the caster); systems with the same follow.group share one follow state per cast (SCHEMA §5.5, 1.19.0)

headAttach.description: system.attachPoint head: an attached system is placed at the caster's rendered eye midpoint and turns with the rendered head (yaw + pitch) every frame; hidden for the caster's own first-person view when firstPerson = hide (SCHEMA §5.7, 1.21.0)

pointLight.description: system.lights: dynamic point lights that really brighten nearby ground, blocks and entities, moving with the system; must use the renderer's lighting, never be faked with glow textures or bloom (SCHEMA §5.6, 1.19.0)

triggeredEnd.description: external trigger signal ends the phased sequence early with its own end branch (e.g. trap explosion) instead of the quiet expire end (SCHEMA §5.1, 1.7.0)

demo.note: non-normative preview scene; not part of the effect
